## Highlights

- Adopt the official go-schedule brand 2.0.0 across documentation, desktop, and supported platform packages, including the current mark and approved social image.
- Pin the complete formal brand archive and provide a checksum-verified import command, declared consumer map, and offline drift check for future reviewed updates.
- Windows packaging uses the official single ICO in place of the retired theme-specific tray icons.
- Attended native appearance checks remain untested under the maintainer's standing waiver; automated CI, exact-source staging, candidate identity, and artifact checksums remain required.

Read the [full changelog](https://github.com/shruggietech/go-schedule/blob/v1.5.1/CHANGELOG.md#151---2026-09-26) for every change.
